paragraphs.text: Khorvath Brightflame and Sylvia Brightspear are a dragon and human knight pair from the plane of Kylem .

Khorvath Brightflame and Sylvia Brightspear are partners who fight together in Valor's Reach on Kylem. Khorvath is a red-scalled dragon while Sylvia is a human who rides him in battle. Sylvia wears silver and gold armor with a stylized eagle on its front while wielding a similarly colored sword that has two stylized wing-shaped guards.
